name: Oz-en-Oisans
description: Oz 3300 is the ski-in/ski-out resort of Oz-en-Oisans, named after Pic Blanc (3,330m — classified 3-star panorama in the Michelin Green Guide). Part of the Alpe d'Huez Grand Domaine (250km). 11 hamlets make up the commune including Oz Village, Le Roberand, Le Bessey, Sardonne, L'Ile d'Oz, Le Boulangeard, Le Pontonnier, La Beurrière, La Voûte, Le Pré de l'Arche, and L'Enversin. Only 55km from Grenoble (1 hour drive) — the closest Grand Domaine access. The Alpette Plateau and Lower Lakes are accessible by cable car. Known for the Oz canyon — a top canyoning spot in Oisans. Family-friendly, ski-in/ski-out, timber and stone architecture. 19th-century church in Oz Village with square bell tower.

overview.atmosphere: Ski-in/ski-out family resort at 1,350m at the foot of Pic Blanc (3,330m — Michelin Green Guide 3-star panorama). Closest resort to Grenoble in the Grand Domaine (55km). 11 hamlets. Gateway to 250km Alpe d'Huez ski area.

beyond_skiing.non_ski_activities: Swimming pool and spa at Oz 3300. Snowpark. Cross-country skiing. Snowshoeing. Hiking trails. Mountain biking (summer). Canyoning.

honest_drawbacks: Requires cable car for full Grand Domaine access
